subjects.name: The Protocols of the Elders of Zion

summary: The history of the Protocols of the Elders of Zion, a forged antisemitic text likely produced in the Russian Empire around 1900 that spread worldwide, fed La Violencia in Colombia and Nazi propaganda behind the Holocaust.
keywords: Dialogue in Hell Between Machiavelli and Montesquieu

evidence.note: start of long prologue on French Revolution, Napoleon and early antisemitism; treated as background
Joly's 1864 satire identified as the direct source text; sets covered_span start
host dates the first version of the Protocols to the late 1890s
Okhrana's foreign office in France and the Dreyfus affair as the likely origin setting
Colombia segment begins: Jesuit clergy bring the Protocols to Latin America after WWI
Laureano Gomez's anti-Masonic, antisemitic campaign and 1942 speech
partisan repression after 1946 escalates into La Violencia, about 200,000 dead
Swiss Jewish groups sue the National Front; the Bern trial and Nazi spin of the appeal
Goebbels, Hitler and Streicher's use of the Protocols in Nazi propaganda
Hitler's 1942 speech and the Holocaust; latest period covered at length
legacy segment: NWO, Illuminati and QAnon as descendants of the Protocols; sets reaches_present

notes: The 1789-1881 prologue (French Revolution, Barruel, the 1806 Tsarist Appeal, Marx, Marr) takes much of part 1 but is treated as background, so covered_span starts at Joly's 1864 text; a reviewer may prefer 1789. Host dates the first version to about 1896-97; most historians put first publication in 1903. Setting order puts Colombia first as the harm with the most airtime, ahead of Germany.
